astm_d1748_specs.standard_title: ASTM D1748 - Rust Protection by Metal Preservatives in the Humidity Cabinet
astm_d1748_specs.specimen_dimensions: Metal panel exposed in humidity cabinet at 48.9°C (120°F)
astm_d1748_specs.measurement_area: Center 50 mm x 50 mm active evaluation zone (excluding edge effects)
astm_d1748_specs.measuring_plate: Transparent cross-cut overlay 60 mm x 80 mm with 0.5 mm cross lines forming 100 squares (10x10 grid, 5 mm x 5 mm each)
astm_d1748_specs.counting_rule: Count each box (1 to 100) that contains at least 1 visible rust dot. Special propagation rule: If rust extends/crosses over the cross cut line into an adjacent square, that adjacent square is counted as rusted.

grid_visualizer_10x10.concept: Interactive SVG / HTML 10x10 Matrix simulating 50x50mm central inspection zone and 60x80mm physical frame
features: Interactive toggle of rusted boxes with click to audit AI detection
Visual propagation indicator showing cross-cut overflow lines (0.5mm cross lines)
Highlighting of 50x50mm active evaluation zone border with dimension calipers
High-contrast toggle: Raw Photo, Grid Overlay, AI Mask, Combined

result_grade_card.concept: Tactical telemetry gauge displaying Total Rusted Squares (0-100) & Grade Badge A-E with APCA high contrast
features: Large grade indicator (Grade A/B/C/D/E) with pass/fail threshold
Radial or linear progress of rusted area percentage (e.g. 14 / 100 boxes = 14%)
Analysis Notes block formatted with metallurgical terminology
Export PDF report button powered by jsPDF & jsPDF-autotable

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow exact file extensions: frontend uses .jsx and .js (not .tsx)
Always maintain consistent dark mode palette with #0A1420 background, #112033 cards, and #00D2D3 / #FF5722 kinetic accents
DO NOT use full-screen flat gradients or default SaaS blues. Rely on crisp 1px borders (border-zinc-700/80) and subtle inner highlights
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, table row, and modal has a descriptive data-testid matching kebab-case role conventions
Include both demo/preset sample photos with pre-analyzed 100-grid states (Grade A, Grade B, Grade C, Grade D, Grade E) for instant testing without uploading files
Support single image upload with live AI Vision analysis simulation or backend endpoint call
Include sample PDF export with ASTM D1748 official layout, metadata, 10x10 grid matrix visualization, and inspector signature block
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for modals, dropdowns, headers, or popovers
